releases.title: Clearer Settings

highlights.title: Sections you can see
highlights.text: Each Settings section now sits in its own card, so you can tell where it starts and ends.

highlights.title: Quieter headings
highlights.text: Section names are small grey capitals, so they no longer look like settings.

highlights.title: In every palette
highlights.text: The cards follow your colours, text size and layout, light or dark.

changes: Settings (app-blueprints · settings 1.1.0): each section's rows sit in one card, with a thin border and a slightly lighter background, under a small muted uppercase heading
The changed-count line and a section's explanation sit outside the cards; Built with is a card too

releases.title: A tidier portfolio

highlights.title: Briefing folds away
highlights.text: Once you've moved on to another tab, the briefing shrinks to its headline; tap to open it.

highlights.title: Invested and gained
highlights.text: Each stock shows what you put in and what you've gained or lost, in your currency.

highlights.title: Private too
highlights.text: Both amounts hide with the eye, like the rest of your money.

changes: The ✦ AI briefing on the portfolio folds and unfolds by tapping its header (or its headline when folded); folded, it shows the headline and the buy, hold and sell counts
After you leave the Portfolio tab, the briefing comes back folded and stays folded, even after reopening Stockit, until a new briefing arrives
Each owned stock in the portfolio shows Invested (shares × average price) and the gain or loss with its percentage, in your currency; foreign stocks convert at today's rate
Both hide in privacy mode

releases.title: Safer with your data

highlights.title: A damaged file can't stop you
highlights.text: If a saved file can't be read, Stockit keeps a copy, starts it fresh and saves your changes again.

highlights.title: Told, not hidden
highlights.text: A short note says when Stockit kept a copy of data it couldn't read.

highlights.title: The right Add key
highlights.text: Turn on AI now highlights Add key on the provider marked In use.

changes: Safe start-up 1.1.0: a file that arrived damaged is copied aside as `<name>.broken-<time>.json` and started from its default, so saving carries on; only a file iCloud didn't deliver is never written
AI invitation 1.2.1: Turn on AI pulses Add key on the card of the provider in use (`.aicard.active`), not the first one in the sheet
fixes: One damaged data file stopped every later save of that file until it was fixed by hand
Turn on AI pulsed the first Add key in AI settings instead of the provider in use

releases.title: AI, from the start

highlights.title: From the first launch
highlights.text: Without a key, the AI invitation now shows the first time you open Stockit.

highlights.title: One tap to set it up
highlights.text: Turn on AI opens AI settings with Add key highlighted.

highlights.title: Still never pushy
highlights.text: Later waits a few days, and Don't remind me again ends it for good.

changes: AI invitation 1.2.0: no first-day wait; it can show on the first launch, right after installing

releases.title: No key, no AI

highlights.title: The key decides
highlights.text: Without a key AI is off, so the invitation can show again, even if you had a key before.

highlights.title: Right after you remove it
highlights.text: Remove your last key and the invitation can show the next time you open Stockit.

highlights.title: Still never pushy
highlights.text: Later waits a few days, and Don't remind me again still ends it for good.

changes: AI invitation 1.1.0: whether a key exists is the only test; a key you had before no longer turns the invitation off for good
Removing the last key makes it eligible from the next launch, without the first-day wait
fixes: The invitation never appeared for anyone who had a key when 1.13.0 first ran, even after removing it

releases.title: An invitation to AI

highlights.title: See what AI adds
highlights.text: Now and then, without a key, Stockit shows what AI adds: the briefing, ideas and stories.

highlights.title: Three steps to turn it on
highlights.text: Turn on AI opens AI settings with Add key highlighted; the rest takes a minute.

highlights.title: Never in the way
highlights.text: Later waits a few days, Don't remind me ends it, and it never shows during a demo or Listen.

changes: AI invitation (app-blueprints · ai-invitation 1.0.1): an animated card on launch, only without an AI key, at most every 3 days (weekly after the fourth Later), never on the first day or with an update offer
Turn on AI opens AI settings with the Add key button pulsing; Later, a tap outside, or Don't remind me again
Never while privacy is on (the eye) or while Listen is reading aloud
Adding a key ends the invitations for good

releases.title: Checks that read your totals

highlights.title: Shares from the totals
highlights.text: When your bank shows only a price and a position's value, Stockit works out the shares.

highlights.title: Average price from the gain
highlights.text: A value and its gain in the stock's currency give your average price too.

highlights.title: Honest matches
highlights.text: A position with only a price is marked Price checked, not Matches.

changes: The portfolio check reads each position's total value and its currency, and the gain or loss shown (amount and percentage)

Shares are worked out as value ÷ price when the screenshot doesn't show them, and compared with Stockit's; a value in another currency than the price goes through today's rate and is marked approximate
Average price is worked out as (value − gain) ÷ shares when value, gain and stock share a currency; for foreign stocks it isn't, because brokers count the gain at the rates of the day you bought
A new Position value line compares Stockit's value with your broker's, with the broker's gain beside it
When a screenshot shows shares and a value that don't add up, the card says so
Positions with only a price are marked ✓ Price checked instead of ✓ Matches
Cash and bank accounts, account numbers (IBANs) and other personal identifiers on a screenshot are ignored

releases.title: Privacy for demos

highlights.title: One tap to hide
highlights.text: Tap the small eye by Updated to hide your amounts when you show Stockit to someone.

highlights.title: Your money, masked
highlights.text: Portfolio value, gains, today's money, shares and average prices become ••••.

highlights.title: Still a full demo
highlights.text: Prices, percentages, charts, news and ideas stay visible, so everything still works.

changes: A small eye button beside Updated, at the top left, turns privacy mode on and off; it turns blue while your amounts are hidden, and stays on until you tap it again

Hidden: portfolio value, today's and since-you-bought amounts, each position's shares, value, today and gain, average prices, Flash cards' shares and today's money, and the portfolio check's amounts (editing waits until privacy is off)
Amounts and share counts inside ✦ AI texts (briefing, stories) and in your strategies and their suggestions are masked too
With privacy on, the widget shows percentages only, even when Show portfolio value in the widget is on
Percentages, market prices, charts, headlines and ideas stay visible

releases.title: Strategies, suggested and yours

highlights.title: Suggested strategies
highlights.text: Fresh plans for your portfolio and watchlist, drawn from your strategies and today's prices.

highlights.title: Keep, edit, refine
highlights.text: Keep a suggestion as is or edit it first; every strategy of yours can be changed any time.

highlights.title: Never stale
highlights.text: Suggestions and Where it stands refresh every day, or every 6 h, 12 h or 2 days, as you choose.

changes: Ideas › My strategies › ✦ Suggested for you: 3 new strategies (1 to 5 in Settings › Strategy suggestions), written in the first person with a timing, the numbers behind them and the tickers involved (tap one to open it)
Keep a suggestion as it is, Edit, then keep, or Dismiss it; kept ones are marked From a ✦ suggestion
Every strategy has Edit: change its words and timing any time; edited ones show when they were changed

Suggestions refresh on their own when they're older than you chose (every day by default; 6 h, 12 h, 2 days or only when you tap Refresh), when Stockit opens, after a refresh or when you open Ideas, so prices and exchange rates are current
Each refresh also updates Where it stands for your own strategies, with when it was written
AI settings › What AI does: a switch for Suggested strategies; token usage counts Strategy suggestions
fixes: The price-trend line under an idea's performance no longer sits against the box above it

releases.title: A clearer portfolio check

highlights.title: Always one tap away
highlights.text: A ✓ icon on your portfolio opens the check; on your first launches a big button shows the way.

highlights.title: See what you upload
highlights.text: Your screenshots appear right away; remove one, add more, then Check, with a progress bar.

highlights.title: Every stock marked
highlights.text: Each result says Matches, Different, Price doesn't match, Not in Stockit or Not on your screenshots.

changes: The big Check against your broker button shows on the first three launches with owned stocks, then shrinks into a ✓ icon on the portfolio summary after six seconds; the icon stays there
Screenshots are added one by one and shown at once as thumbnails, numbered, each with × to remove; Check stays off until there's at least one
While checking, a progress bar with a percentage says what's happening (reading with ✦ AI, then checking each stock), and the screenshots show a scanning light
Results are all open, with no folded lists: a summary with counts for each kind of result, the totals compared and the screenshots, then one card per stock, problems first and matches last
Each card has a coloured badge and edge, and a Stockit-versus-broker comparison with ✓ or ≠ on every line

Price doesn't match explains that, if the screenshot is recent, Stockit may hold the wrong shares or average price, or another listing of the company, and offers the shares and average price to correct
New check starts over; Clear results forgets the screenshots

releases.title: Check against your broker

highlights.title: Check with screenshots
highlights.text: Snap your broker's portfolio; ✦ AI reads every position and Stockit compares it with yours.

highlights.title: Every gap found
highlights.text: Missing stocks, ones you no longer hold, different shares or average prices, and prices that don't match.

highlights.title: You decide
highlights.text: Nothing changes on its own: apply, edit or ignore each suggestion.

changes: Portfolio › Check against your broker: choose one or more screenshots of your broker's or bank's app (up to 6, set in Settings › Portfolio check)
✦ AI reads each position as shown: ticker or name, shares, average price, current price, value and currency, plus the broker and total; numbers with decimal commas read right
Stockit matches positions with your stocks by ticker, by ticker without its exchange suffix, or by company name
Differs: shares, average price or price differ beyond your tolerance (1% and 5% by default); edit the suggested shares and average price, then Apply these or Keep Stockit's
On your screenshots, not in Stockit: Add to portfolio with the shares and average price shown (converted to the stock's currency), or Find it when Yahoo doesn't know the name
In Stockit, not on your screenshots: Remove (two taps), Move to watchlist or Keep
A stock on your watchlist that the screenshot shows you own: Move to portfolio
A price that's far off is explained: an older screenshot, another currency, or another listing of the same company
The screenshot's total is compared with Stockit's; token usage counts Portfolio checks separately

releases.title: Ideas you can judge

highlights.title: The numbers behind every idea
highlights.text: P/E, dividend yield, market cap, 50- and 200-day averages, RSI, range and more on each idea.

highlights.title: Look before you add
highlights.text: Tap an idea to open its full stock page: chart, numbers, news and story, without adding it.

highlights.title: A tidier Ideas tab
highlights.text: My strategies, your themes and the ideas fold away, and your themes now live right there.

changes: Each ✦ idea shows P/E, forward P/E, dividend yield, market cap, 50-day and 200-day averages (with how far the price is from each), RSI over 14 days, beta, analyst target and rating, profit margin and revenue growth; tap any for what it means
Each idea also shows its sector, exchange, 52-week range, 1-month, 6-month and 1-year performance, and its price trend

Tap an idea (or See everything) to open its full stock page, the same as for your own stocks: charts from 1D to 5Y, numbers, headlines with TL;DRs, the ✦ story and whether its market is open; then Add to watchlist or I own this
Ideas › Themes you like: add and remove themes right in the Ideas tab (they're no longer in Settings)
My strategies, Themes you like and Stocks worth a closer look fold open and closed; Stockit remembers which you folded
Stock pages gain 50-day average, 200-day average and RSI tiles

releases.title: All your money, one currency

highlights.title: One currency for everything
highlights.text: Stocks from every market add up in euros, dollars or the currency you choose.

highlights.title: Today's rates
highlights.text: Values, today's change and gains convert at the latest exchange rate, the currency's own move included.

highlights.title: In the widget too
highlights.text: With amounts on, the widget shows your portfolio in the same currency.

changes: Settings › Portfolio › Show your money in: Auto (the currency most of your money is in), EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN, JPY, CAD, AUD or HKD
Portfolio value, today's change, gain since you bought and the split across holdings now add up every stock in that currency, instead of showing other currencies apart
Exchange rates load from Yahoo Finance with your prices (kept for 30 minutes); a new stock's currency loads when you add it, and changing the currency converts at once
Today's change in your currency includes the currency's move since yesterday; what you paid is converted at today's rate
A stock's page shows its value, today and gain in your currency, with its own currency underneath; London prices in pence are converted too
Rows and Flash cards show values and today's profit in your currency; sorting by value uses it
The briefing and the widget use the same total
fixes: Changes in money show two decimals, even when they're under one unit

releases.title: Your markets, your plans

highlights.title: Charts you can touch
highlights.text: New 1D and 1W charts; touch or drag any chart to see the price at that moment.

highlights.title: Markets open or closed
highlights.text: Every stock shows if its market is open, and a Markets tab counts down to each open and close.

highlights.title: My strategies
highlights.text: Add your own plans in Ideas; ✦ ideas, the briefing and stories follow them. Retire them when done.

changes: Stock charts: new 1D (from yesterday's close) and 1W ranges beside 1M, 6M, 1Y and 5Y; a day and a week are at most five minutes old
Touch or drag across any chart to see the price, the time or date and the change at that moment; it stays a moment after you let go
Each stock shows whether its market is open now (Portfolio, Watchlist, Flash), and its page says when it closes or opens, in your time

New Markets tab: the markets where your stocks trade first, then 16 others, each open or closed (or on lunch break) with a countdown to the next open or close, local and your-time hours, and the trading day's progress
Holidays: for markets where you hold stocks, Yahoo's own session times are used on top of the regular hours
Ideas › My strategies: write your own plans with an optional timing, see them all, retire them (and bring them back or delete them)
✦ Ideas serve your active strategies, say which strategy each idea is for, and add a short Where it stands for every strategy; the briefing and stock stories take your strategies into account too
The Ideas tab shows without an AI key, for your strategies
fixes: All five tabs fit on one line

releases.title: Opens every time

highlights.title: No more blank screen
highlights.text: Opening Stockit from the widget shows the app at once; your stocks load behind it.

highlights.title: Safe with quick taps
highlights.text: Tapping the widget several times no longer stacks up copies of the app.

highlights.title: Start-up log
highlights.text: Settings › Updates shows what happened the last times Stockit opened.

changes: An empty dark window appears first and the page is built inside it while it's visible, so iOS always draws it (the fix BlogPulse 1.9.2 uses)
Stocks, prices, AI texts and usage are read after the first screen is shown, in pieces, each with a time limit; "Loading your stocks…" shows meanwhile
If iCloud is slow to hand over a file, Stockit opens with what it has, says so, and saves nothing over your data until you reopen it
Refreshing prices starts 0.7 s after the first screen, the update check after 3.5 s and the widget icon after 6 s
Only one Stockit window at a time: a new run waits at most 1.5 s for an older one, then opens anyway
If opening ever stalls, the screen shows what Stockit was waiting for
fixes: Blank screen when opening Stockit from the widget

releases.title: Tap a stock, hear its news

highlights.title: Tap a stock to listen
highlights.text: Tap any stock in Flash and its news starts playing; tap again to pause.

highlights.title: Three articles, read in full
highlights.text: Stockit reads three full articles per stock, skipping ones it can't open, and tells a 350–550 word story.

highlights.title: See what you heard
highlights.text: The story appears under the card, with which articles were read in full.

changes: Tap a stock's name in Flash to hear the story of its news; tap it again to pause or resume. The speaker beside the ticker shows when it's preparing or playing; Details › opens the stock's page
Stockit now reads three full articles for each story: when an article can't be opened (paywall, blocked page), it reads the next headline instead, from up to eight
✦ Stories go through each article's facts, numbers, names and reasons in 350 to 550 words; a story that comes back too short is asked for again
The story you heard appears under the card, with its sources, how many words of each were read, and which were headline only
Yahoo's cookie-consent page in Europe is answered once (as "Accept all") and its cookies kept, so Yahoo articles can be read
Other recent headlines are given to the AI as context for the story

releases.title: Hear the whole story

highlights.title: Listen to a stock's news
highlights.text: Its top three articles are read in full and told as one story, then what it could mean.

highlights.title: Fuller TL;DRs
highlights.text: Every ✦ TL;DR now tells the story in a few paragraphs, with the key facts and figures.

highlights.title: More articles readable
highlights.text: Google News links now lead to the publisher's article, so far fewer TL;DRs stop at the headline.

changes: Listen on each Flash card: Stockit reads that stock's top articles in full and ✦ AI tells them as one spoken story of 250 to 400 words, naming its sources, then what it could mean for the stock
Listen at the top of Flash plays the story of every open card in turn; the player starts at once and the next story is prepared while one is playing
Without an AI key, Listen reads each article's key sentences in turn instead of just its headline
✦ TL;DRs now include the story in two or three paragraphs and 4 to 6 key facts, and Listen reads the story too; up to 12,000 characters of the article are sent (Settings › AI limits)
Google News links are resolved to the publisher's own article before reading
Articles are kept in memory while Stockit is open, so a TL;DR and a story about the same headlines load each page once
Stories and TL;DRs written without AI are rewritten with AI once you add a key
Token usage counts News stories to listen to separately

releases.title: Flash, at a glance

highlights.title: Your stake beside the news
highlights.text: Each Flash card now shows your shares, today's profit or loss and Stockit's view.

highlights.title: Analysts and the crowd
highlights.text: The average Wall Street rating and the StockTwits mood, right next to the headlines.

highlights.title: Fold what you've read
highlights.text: Fold a card once read; it opens again by itself when new headlines arrive.

changes: Flash cards fill the left column: shares, today's profit or loss in your currency, the ✦ buy, hold or sell view (or the price trend without AI), the analysts' average rating and the crowd's mood
✓ Read — fold it: a read card shrinks to one line (ticker, today's move, view, when the newest headline arrived); it opens again, marked New, when a newer headline arrives
Fold all and Open all at the top of Flash; Listen reads only the cards that are open
Flash ranks headlines that name the company first and leaves out quote and listing pages (such as "stock price, news, quote and history" or bond-yield pages)

releases.title: Flash news, read to you

highlights.title: Flash news
highlights.text: A new tab with each stock beside its top three headlines, ranked by recency and source.

highlights.title: TL;DR of any headline
highlights.text: Tap a headline for the gist and what it could mean for the stock, then open the source.

highlights.title: Read aloud
highlights.text: Listen to the briefing, stories, TL;DRs and Flash with iPhone or ✦ AI voices.

changes: New Flash tab: every stock on the left, its top headlines on the right (owned stocks first, biggest first); Settings › Headlines sets how many, 1 to 5
Tap any headline, in Flash or on a stock's page, for a TL;DR: one-line gist, key points and what it could mean for the stock, then Read the full article at the publisher
TL;DRs are written by ✦ AI when you have a key, or taken from the article itself without one; Google News links are followed to the publisher where the page names it
Read aloud, as in BlogPulse: Listen on the briefing, each stock's story, every TL;DR and the whole Flash, with a player bar to pause, skip and stop
Settings › Listening: iPhone voices (filter female or male, speed, pitch) or ✦ AI voices from OpenAI (voice, speech model, how it should sound, speed)
Token usage counts Article TL;DRs and Read aloud (characters) separately
Settings › AI limits: how much article text is sent for a TL;DR
fixes: Opinions and Written notes sit on their own line above the buttons, so they're no longer squeezed

releases.title: Your stocks, explained

highlights.title: Portfolio at a glance
highlights.text: Owned stocks and a watchlist with live prices, today's move and gains since you bought.

highlights.title: A daily briefing
highlights.text: Claude or OpenAI turns prices and headlines into a plain-English story and a view per stock.

highlights.title: Bring them in fast
highlights.text: Search, paste a list, open a broker CSV or snap a screenshot of Apple's Stocks app.

changes: Portfolio and Watchlist tabs: price, today's change, a one-month trend line and a buy, hold or sell view per stock; sort by value, today, signal or A–Z
Portfolio value, today's change and gain since you bought, with the split across your biggest holdings
Stock page: 1M, 6M, 1Y and 5Y chart, your position, key numbers (P/E, market cap, dividend, analyst target, margins, growth, 52-week range) with a plain-words explanation on tap
Headlines from Yahoo Finance and Google News, and the crowd's mood from StockTwits (each can be switched off)
✦ Portfolio briefing, a story per stock (why buy, what could go wrong, what to watch) and new ideas, with your investing style: Cautious, Balanced or Adventurous
Add stocks by search, a pasted list with shares and average price, a broker CSV, or ✦ a screenshot
Optional Finnhub key as a backup source for company numbers
Home Screen and Lock Screen widget in the shared frame; shows percentages only unless you turn on amounts
Shared blueprints from day one: in-app updates, Settings, AI configuration, launch screen and widgets (Settings › Built with)
